claims.claim_text: Self-consistency: sample several outputs and use their agreement, which the authors call "consistency," as the uncertainty estimate
claims.quote: Additionally, we found that the consistency (in terms of % of decodes agreeing with the final aggregated answer) is highly correlated with accuracy (Figure 5, over GSM8K). This suggests that one can use self-consistency to provide an uncertainty estimate of the model in its generated solutions. In other words, one can use low consistency as an indicator that the model has low confidence; i.e., self-consistency confers some ability for the model to "know when it doesn't know".
